```yaml
name: Regression Tests

on:
  schedule:
    # Run daily at 00:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      python_version:
        description: 'Python version to run regression tests on'
        required: false
        default: '3.11'
        type: choice
        options:
          - '3.8'
          - '3.9'
          - '3.10'
          - '3.11'
          - '3.12'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  regression-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version:
          - "3.8"
          - "3.9"
          - "3.10"
          - "3.11"
          - "3.12"
        test-group:
          - regression

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Run Regression Tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest tests/ -m regression -v --junitxml=results/junit-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
        continue-on-error: false

      - name: Upload Test Results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: regression-test-results-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          path: results/junit-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Upload Test Results to Codecov
        if: always()
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: results/junit-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
          flags: regression,python-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          name: regression-python-${{ matrix.python-version }}
```
